description: The data part of the A2A artifact the analysis agent attaches when it completes a task. The text part carries the same answer as prose; this is what a consumer reads to show which numbers the answer was computed from.

sample.question: Quale opzione conviene, a parita' di costo?
sample.summary: La serie e' dominata da un valore isolato: senza quello, i valori stanno fra 11 e 15.
